title: Division 26 (Electrical) — Practice Suite
description: Public practice suite for the Division 26 / electrical vertical. Electrical takeoff is fundamentally symbol counting, so this starter suite exercises the fixture-count competency across the two canonical electrical count families: lighting fixtures (Type A troffers on a reflected ceiling plan, with exit-sign and emergency-light distractors) and wiring devices (duplex receptacles on a power plan, with switch and data-jack distractors). The real skill is symbol discrimination — counting the right symbol and rejecting the look-alikes. Answer keys are embedded in each *.task.json. The ranked counterpart ships WITHOUT groundTruth (held by the Academy) — see tasks/README.md.
